intro.text: A member of Migs's eight-strong gang in Elendel.

items.text: On the morning of Wax's wedding, the constables raided the gang's hideout in an old pub after failing to talk them into surrendering. Wax stormed in while Wayne, disguised as one of the gang, knocked out several of them, Slink included. Wax told the gang's leader that, if he had his way, the captured men would not hang.
